resumen: Sorcerer with the **lowest GS of all recorded players** (2834; CP 182k) and 5th in DPS in both raids (35.8k, 15–19% below average). Dies the earliest, though they improved from one night to the next.
fortalezas: Improvement between nights: first death from 94 s to 117 s and deaths per attempt from 1.81 to 1.47.
Takes less damage than average: when they survive, they hold up well.
mejorar: Dies earlier than the rest on both nights (94 s versus 119 s; 117 s versus 132 s).
Main causes: 2920718 with 1802850 (7), 2920717 with 1802830 (6) and 1802750 (5). 10 deaths with no recorded ability.
recomendaciones: Upgrading gear is the most direct improvement: more damage and more margin to survive hits.
Learn the opening timings (1802730 at 8 s, 1802740 at 16 s, 1802750 around 60–75 s): many of your early deaths are there.
In the zone phase, leave 2920717 and 2920718 as soon as they appear, even if you lose a cast.
